review_notes: Slip gain hook is neutral on legacy and Mastery controllers; final Climb normal decay zero permits positive slope accumulation without changing force, timestep, Slip duration or Runaway boundary.
Environment factors are applied before existing Mastery effects once; steep/gentle recovery floors and once-per-run/forward-frontier abilities remain intact.
Recovery scales dt and requires release; no new instantaneous toggle grant or repeatable ability reset was introduced. This is not an exhaustive proof against all input strategies.
The test unit and integration tests use isolated/artificial fixtures. New user difficulty effects are not validated by archival S190 measurements, which use a different controller.

Preliminary final-candidate seed101 witnesses reach250 without upgrades and complete1000 with all30 optimized, avoiding a claim of universal early impossibility. Regular/skilled failures remain observed policy failures.
Hold-D timeout must remain distinct from death; restored saves intentionally pick up current environment config rather than preserving an older difficulty profile.

Legacy main.gd now contains a neutral hint text method; default returned text and hint priority remain the same. MVP override tells player to release pushing. Prior original-main byte-equivalence evidence applies only to the preceding version.
